title: Chronicles of Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Discover Japan's enchanting blend of ancient traditions, futuristic cities, serene temples, and stunning landscapes, making every moment an amazing experience.
Explore Himeji Castle, one of Japan's best-preserved feudal fortresses, and admire its stunning white facade and intricate defensive design.
Cross the iconic Togetsukyo Bridge in Arashiyama, and witness the breathtaking views of the Katsura River, surrounded by lush mountains and vibrant seasonal foliage.
Step into Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a picturesque village at the foot of Mount Fuji, offering a glimpse into Japan’s rustic past amidst stunning natural scenery.
Witness the unique Kibitsu-zukuri architecture of Kibitsu-Jinja, an ancient shrine, and feel the spiritual energy as you walk through its lantern-adorned corridors.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo

know_before_you_go: Remove shoes before entering homes or certain traditional establishments.
English is not widely spoken outside major tourist areas.
Learning basic Japanese phrases or using a translation app can be helpful.
ATMs that accept foreign cards are available at convenience stores and post offices.
Follow local customs, such as not pointing feet, maintaining quiet in public places, and respecting religious sites.
Japan experiences a range of climates, from snowy winters in the north to hot summers in the south.
All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Alcoholic Drinks are not included in the package.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo, the capital of Japan! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel and check-in. Then, relax for some time, and in the evening, get transferred to Tokyo Station for your metro (tickets included) to the vibrant Shinjuku district. Once there, explore Shinjuku at your leisure, where you can visit Golden Gai & soak-in its vibrant atmosphere and Shinjuku Gyoen, one of Tokyo's largest and most famous parks. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo

days.title: Tokyo Sightseing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, prepare for a Tokyo sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to Zojoji Temple, renowned for its historic charm and beautiful traditional architecture. Next, pay your respects at the Meiji Shrine, followed by a drive through the lively Omotesando district. Continue to visit the majestic Imperial Palace, followed by a visit to the iconic Nijubashi Bridge. Explore the electric town, Akihabara, & other iconic spots before getting driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour   on a Shared basis

days.title: Transfer to Kawaguchiko | Visit to Arakurayama Sengen Park and Shrine | Kawaguchi Lake Boat Ride | Trip to Mt. Fuji-5th Station
days.desc: Today, check-out from your hotel and get transferred to Kawaguchiko. Upon arrival, you'll be taken to visit the famous Arakurayama Sengen Park to witness its beautiful pagodas and views of Mount Fuji. Next, visit Fuji Sengen Shrine, a Shinto shrine with a magical atmosphere, followed by a relaxing boat ride on Kawaguchi Lake. Then, get driven to Mt. Fuji's fifth station and take-in the stunning vistas of Mt. Fuji. Later, upon your arrival at the Kawaguchiko hotel, check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Visit to Arakurayama Sengen Park and Sengen Shrine

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Visit to Iyashi no Sato Nenba, Shiraito Falls & Toyota Museum
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to the City of Ten Thousand Shrines, Kyoto. On the way, make a stop to visit Iyashi no Sato Nenba, which has been transformed into a museum with traditional thatched-roof houses and cultural exhibits. Then, stop to visit the stunning Shiraito Falls, with its scenic backdrop of Mount Fuji. Next, explore the Toyota Museum to learn about the advancements in automotive technology. Later, upon your arrival in Kyoto, check-in to your hotel for your overnight stay.

items.title: Visit to Iyashi No Sato Nenba
Check-in at Super Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: The Prince Kyoto Takaragaike, Autograph Collection

days.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time in Gion
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to explore Kyoto on a sightseeing tour. Begin with Arashiyama and cross the scenic Togetsukyo Bridge, a historic and picturesque wooden bridge. Next, get driven to pay your respects at the famous Tenryuji Temple & admire the vibrant torii gates at Fushimi Inari Shrine. Then, witness the traditional architecture at the Imperial Palace & the Kinkakuji Temple. Later, get driven to Gion, where you can visit Kenninji Temple & Yasaka Shrine. Afterwards, return to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka via Nara | Nara Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time in Dotonbori
days.desc: Today, after check-out, get transferred to Osaka, Japan's vibrant city. En route, make a stop in Nara and visit the UNESCO-listed Todaiji Temple, home to the Great Buddha, an iconic statue. Next, explore Horyuji, another UNESCO-listed site, & witness the world's oldest wooden buildings and Buddhist art. Later, upon reaching Osaka, check-in at the hotel. In the evening, get driven to Dotonbori District, where you can visit Dotonbori Zaza & Ebisu Bridge. Afterwards, return to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | En-route visit Himeji Castle | Okayama Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to Okayama. En route, make a stop in Himeji and visit the UNESCO-listed Himeji Castle, known for its striking white exterior. Then, take a stop at Okayama & explore Korakuen, one of Japan's most beautiful gardens, offering stunning views of Okayama Castle. Next, visit the Kibitsu-Jinja, a Shinto shrine known for its unique 360-mt corridor. Later, enjoy your leisure time exploring the city before getting transferred to your hotel for check-in & overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Leisure Time in Kurashiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour | Visit to Itsukushima Shrine
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Hiroshima. En route, make a stop in Kurashiki, where you can visit the Ohara Museum & Achi Shrine. Then, get driven to Hiroshima & enjoy a walking tour to visit the iconic Peace Memorial, the famous Atomic Bomb Dome, & the Peace Memorial Museum. Next, get driven to Miyajimaguchi Ferry Terminal for your ferry to Miyajima Island. Once there, pay your respects at the Itsukushima Shrine. Later, get driven to your hotel in Hiroshima for check-in & overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Matsuyama by boat | Cable Car Ride to Matsuyama Castle | Visit to Ishiteji Temple & Dogo Onsen
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to Hiroshima Port & hop-on your boat to the largest city on Shikoku Island. Then, disembark from your boat at Matsuyama Port and get driven to Chojaganaru Station for your scenic cable car ride to Matsuyama Castle. At the top, explore the historic fortress and soak-in the panoramic views. Next, admire the architecture of Ishiteji Temple, followed by a visit to the Dogo Onsen, a bathhouse. Later, get driven to your hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Matsuyama Castle with Cable Car Ride
Check-in at ANA Crowne Plaza Matsuyama, an IHG Hotel

days.title: Transfer to Kobe | En Route visit to Kotohira Shrine, Ritsurin & Naruto Bridge
days.desc: Today, check-out from your hotel and get transferred to Kobe. En route, visit a Shinto shrine, Kotohira Shrine, dedicated to sailors and seafarers. Continue your journey and make a stop in Takamatsu to visit the famous Ritsurin Garden and soak-in the scenic views of Mount Shiun. Afterwards, make a stop & visit the iconic Naruto Bridge to walk along the Uzu no Michi, a glass-floored walkway, under the bridge. Then, get transferred to the hotel in Kobe and check-in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Earthquake Museum | Departure from Osaka
days.desc: After check-out, you'll be taken to visit the famous Earthquake Memorial Museum, dedicated to preserving the memory of devastating earthquakes and features interactive exhibits, survivor testimonies, and detailed reconstructions of the earthquake's impact. Continue to the second-largest city in Japan, Osaka and this marks the end of your amazing Japan trip!
